AURIONPRO AND WAAREE TRANSPOWER WIN ₹100 CRORE ORDERS

Aurionpro announced a fresh ₹100 crore AI data centre contract in Southern India, adding to an earlier hyperscaler deal announced this year. Waaree Transpower secured an order worth over ₹100 crore from NTPC for a grid‑scale battery storage project.
The contracts expand both companies’ presence in high‑growth sectors, with Aurionpro’s total hyperscaler orders now exceeding ₹400 crore and Waaree Transpower entering NTPC’s approved supplier ecosystem for specialised grid equipment.
